item.title: 01 — The Numbers That Run Everything
item.description: Before we touch a single neuron, we need to speak its language. Vectors, matrices, derivatives, and the chain rule — the math that makes neural networks tick.

item.title: 02 — Meet the World's Dumbest Brain Cell
item.description: One neuron. A handful of weights. A rule so simple it fits in one line. And yet — it learns. This is the perceptron, and it’s where everything begins.

item.title: 03 — The Switch That Isn't Really a Switch
item.description: Sigmoid, ReLU, tanh, softmax — the nonlinear magic that makes depth actually mean something.
